fact_text: Dewan Farooq Motors said it began electric vehicle work in June 2022 and was the first Pakistani assembler to receive a manufacturing certificate from the Engineering Development Board.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First Locally Built EV in PKR 4 Million | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-22)

fact_text: The company's Honry EV comes in a 2.0 and a 3.0 variant; the 2.0 has an 18 kWh battery and about 200 km range per charge.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First Locally Built EV in PKR 4 Million | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-22)

fact_text: The Honry 3.0 has a 29 kWh battery and the company said it covers about 300 km on one charge.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First Locally Built EV in PKR 4 Million | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-22)

fact_text: The company gave a price of about PKR 4 million for the Honry 2.0 variant.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First Locally Built EV in PKR 4 Million | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-22)

fact_text: The company gave a price of about PKR 5 million for the Honry 3.0 variant.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First Locally Built EV in PKR 4 Million | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-22)

fact_text: The Honry is charged from a standard 16 to 18 amp household socket; the CEO said it goes from 20% to 80% in about 6 hours and to 100% in 7 to 8 hours.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First Locally Built EV in PKR 4 Million | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-22)

fact_text: The CEO said a typical Karachi city driver covers only 60 to 80 km a day, so one full home charge lasts about three days.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First Locally Built EV in PKR 4 Million | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-22)

fact_text: The CEO said Pakistan spends about 14 to 15 billion dollars a year importing fuel used only for transport, which local EV assembly could reduce.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First Locally Built EV in PKR 4 Million | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-22)

fact_text: The CEO said the government's EV targets for 2030 and 2060 are aggressive but, in the industry's view, achievable.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First Locally Built EV in PKR 4 Million | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-22)

fact_text: The CEO said Pakistan has domestic lithium for batteries and sufficient silica for solar panels, which could support battery and solar manufacturing.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First Locally Built EV in PKR 4 Million | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-22)

fact_text: The CEO argued that EVs, batteries, motor control systems, solar panels and energy storage together form one ecosystem that would reduce the fuel import bill.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First Locally Built EV in PKR 4 Million | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-22)

fact_text: The CEO said US and European solar and auto makers shut down because Chinese prices were too low to compete, and that local assembly has to bring conversion costs down to match.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First Locally Built EV in PKR 4 Million | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-22)

fact_text: The CEO said the company's CNG kit work and a wider rollout of CNG stations offered a precedent: about 3,000 CNG outlets opened in a short time once companies started installing kits.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan’s First Locally Built EV in PKR 4 Million | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-22)
